description: Implementation of a PSR HTTP stream called CallbackStream, which uses a callback to generate stream contents and implements the StreamInterface.

classes.name: CallbackStream
classes.description: A class implementing PSR HTTP StreamInterface that uses a callback to generate stream contents, with methods for attaching/detaching callbacks and handling stream operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the CallbackStream with a callback function.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream by invoking getContents.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by nullifying the callback.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches and returns the current callback.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new callback to the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns null, indicating size is unknown.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws an exception as the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at EOF based on callback presence.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns false; stream is not seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws an exception; seeking is unsupported.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Throws an exception; rewinding is unsupported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns false; stream is not writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception; writing is unsupported.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns false; stream is not readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Throws an exception; reading is unsupported.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Invokes the callback to get stream contents.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata such as EOF status, stream type, and seekability.
